name_en: Nukamiso daki — sardine or mackerel simmered in an aged rice-bran pickling paste
summary_ja: イワシやサバを醤油だしで煮て、代々受け継がれてきたぬか床を溶き入れとろ火で炊く。青魚特有の臭みがぬか床の旨味に変わり、北九州の旧家では嫁ぐ娘に床を分け継がせてきたと伝わる。
summary_en: Sardine or mackerel simmers in a soy broth until a family's aged rice-bran pickling bed is stirred in — the fish's oiliness softens into the bed's savor, in a Kitakyushu tradition where the bed itself was once passed to a daughter as she married out.
source_title: ぬかみそ炊き 福岡県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Gameni — chicken and root vegetables simmered together, Fukuoka's own take on chikuzen-ni
summary_ja: 鶏肉とごぼう、れんこん、たけのこを炒めてから煮含める、正月や祝い事に欠かせない一皿。県外では筑前煮とも呼ばれるが、骨つき肉を使うことがある点で仕立てが異なると伝わる。
summary_en: Chicken and root vegetables — burdock, lotus root, bamboo shoot — are stir-fried, then simmered down for New Year and celebrations. Known elsewhere as chikuzen-ni, this Fukuoka version is said to sometimes keep the bone in.
source_title: がめ煮 福岡県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Okyuto — a firm seaweed jelly sliced thin and dressed with vinegar-soy
summary_ja: エゴノリを煮溶かして固めた海藻ゼリーを薄く切り、酢醤油などで食べる。戦前までは毎朝売り歩く「おきゅうと売り」がいたほど、博多の朝食に欠かせない存在だったと伝わる。
summary_en: Egonori seaweed is boiled down and set into a firm jelly, sliced thin and dressed with vinegar-soy — once so central to Hakata mornings that vendors are said to have sold it door to door before the war.
source_title: おきゅうと 福岡県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Su mochi — freshly pounded New Year mochi torn by hand into grated daikon and citrus
summary_ja: 正月の最後についた餅を片栗粉をつけずに手でちぎり、大根おろしとだいだいの搾り汁、醤油を合わせたたれと和える。豊前地域では正月前の餅つきの締めくくりに皆で食べる風習だという。
summary_en: The last batch of New Year mochi pounding is torn by hand — no starch dusting — and tossed with grated daikon, bitter-orange juice, and soy. In the Buzen area, it's said to be shared out as the pounding session's finale.
source_title: 酢もち 福岡県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Senbuki mage — blanched Welsh onion folded and dressed with mustard-vinegar-miso, alongside river snails
summary_ja: 福岡でわけぎを指す「せんぶき」をゆでて折り曲げ、タニシと酢味噌で和える。3月3日のひな節句に欠かせない筑豊地区の一皿で、寒くなる「たにし寒」の頃がタニシの旬だという。
summary_en: Welsh onion, called 'senbuki' locally, is blanched and folded, then dressed with vinegared miso alongside river snails — a dish for the Hinamatsuri doll festival in the Chikuho area, timed to a late-winter cold snap said to be the snails' season.
source_title: せんぶきまげ 福岡県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Kutsuzoko no nitsuke — sole simmered in a seasoned broth, named for its shoe-sole shape
summary_ja: 有明海でとれる舌平目を「くつぞこ」と呼び、醤油だしでふっくらと煮つける。靴底に似た平たい体つきが名の由来とされ、地元では黒っぽい「クロシタ」を上物として区別しているという。
summary_en: Sole caught in the Ariake Sea, called 'kutsuzoko' — shoe-sole — for its flat shape, is simmered soft in a soy broth. Locals are said to prize the darker-skinned variety as the finer catch.
source_title: くつぞこの煮つけ 福岡県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Ebi zakko — a mix of small shrimp simmered in sweet soy, the broth then used to cook somen
summary_ja: アカエビやサルエビなど数種の小型エビを甘めの醤油でさっと煮て、残った煮汁でそうめんを煮込む。豊前海でまとめて水揚げされる雑多なエビを新鮮なうちに味わう漁師の料理という。
summary_en: Several kinds of small shrimp are quickly simmered in sweetened soy, and the leftover broth then cooks somen noodles — a fisherman's way of using up the mixed catch of small shrimp hauled from the Buzen Sea while it's still fresh.
source_title: えびざっこ 福岡県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
